up: Return all exact activity values for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4513219. For each result, include the assay ChEMBL ID, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard activity value, standard units, and standard relation.
sql: SELECT a.assay_id, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, act.standard_relation FROM activities act JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno WHERE a.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4513219' AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_units IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_relation IS NOT NULL
